''Below are some of the current community projects happening around Wookieepedia. If you are interested in joining in, check out our [[Wookieepedia:Welcome, newcomers|newcomers hub page]] to start your editing journey!''
*[[Wookieepedia:Project Stardust|'''Project Stardust''']] is improving the article for [[Kleya Marki]]. Visit the [[Wookieepedia:Project Stardust: Kleya Marki|project page]] to join the effort!
*The [[Wookieepedia:Featured article nominations|'''Featured article''']], [[Wookieepedia:Good article nominations|'''Good article''']], and [[Wookieepedia:Comprehensive article nominations|'''Comprehensive article]] nomination processes help bring articles up to the highest possible standards. Join the effort by helping review nominations.
*[[Wookieepedia:WookieeProject Creators|'''WookieeProject Creators''']] is adding the full credits to all media articles. You can assist the team by visiting any article on a piece of media and expanding the credits list.
*[[Wookieepedia:WookieeProject Pride|'''WookieeProject Pride''']] is providing citations for pronouns and gender for [[in-universe]] topics. See the [[Wookieepedia:Sourcing|Sourcing policy]] for rules on how to cite pronouns and gender.
